Insanely high-octane and maddeningly fun. Galactic Racer's high-risk high reward arcade racing is by far some of the most fun I've ever had with a racing game, ever. The lack of mode variety is annoying, but the game is just so much fun, and thrilling in so many close call races and tracks, that it's hard to miss all of that. You're just having too much fun on most races to notice. Great game. Really great. Warning that the game needs epic online services to run online races. Just a heads up.

you go so fast and there's glup shittos. just really fun racing.

runs well on linux through proton, though i have had some CTDs, they've always been on transition to a new race or planet, which means i've not lost any progress. not ideal but hasn't really bothered me.

While game can be fun to feel the speed, enjoy burnout like takedowns and idea of building your ride based on how you get your cards drawn and adapting to them through run, I cannot recommend this game until the ABSURD rubberbanding gets toned down as at this moment it is absofuckinglutely outrageous, even older racing games which had obvious rubberbanding to allow both ai to be somewhat challenging, or on other side allow weaker player to have a chance catch up, in here ai will ALWAYS be able to catch up to you even if you take best racing line, all shortcuts, take them down and use your skills. This is most obviously and poorly implemented in 1st acts finale where even you you take out your competitor, be 5s ahead of him (that's a lot for racing game where 1-2 seconds is close) for half a lap (yes that's how fast he can catch up from crash and lap is less than 1m long) and overtake you without ramjet or booster (blue engine light for ramjet and exploding yellow for afterburner) and continue to speed away putting you on 20s lead.

Until this absurdness is toned down, as I don't mind some rubberbanding as done well it can create feeling of challenge, accomplishment and satisfaction from racing, but this one its not only frustrating but also insulting.

To those who are leaving negative Steam reviews specifically about rebinding controls: Steam Input. You can remap any button on your controller using that. Yeah, it's kinda ass to not be able to do it natively in the game, but that being the ONLY thing to leave a bad review about ON STEAM is wild when you consider Steam Input exists.

The game is absolutely beautiful and the racing is good. The game being made by those that made Need for Speed and Burnout definitely shows, especially with Burnout. I loved that series and so far I'm also loving this game.
The rougelite elements was a surprise, but it seems good so far.
There does seem to be some amount of rubberbanding, but I haven't super noticed it after the first run on act 2 and the final boss on act 2.
The shoulder camera is hilariously bad. Devs, just move it more to the right when you talk to someone so you aren't just looking at Shade's back.

Game is fun, feels very fast! It is missing come crucial standart multiplayer features racing games should have though. The devs are working on it... on a 60$ premium game, still working on it huh? Well what we need is 8-12 player custom lobbys and playlists. what the dev team is working on is increasing it only to 6 player custom lobbys from what i read online. Cmon guys. Step it up. You got a good fun game, make it less shitty make it actually awesome! I wanna be able to play with a friends and in my favorite twitch streamers lobby, yaknow?
Really fun rogue-like, but crashes quite a bit, and not in the fun, racecar way.

Yeah, like 3 hours in and this is genuinely a fun racing game that evokes the simple pleasure of pod racing and rouge-lite, etc. Looks great, runs smooth, has an intuitive game progression, and just really feels fun. Haven't been as locked in to a vehicle game outside of flight sims in a while. I don't want to evoke the idea of Star Wars Narrative trappings, but its hard not to say that its fun just being a racing legend in a big galaxy. I would love to use my X-56, a kind of controller. But otherwise, hey, speeder go vroooom!

Fast, snappy, and rewarding. The only problem is the price and depth - one is almost justified because of the quality, the other is understandable given the genre. If neither are too big a barrier for you, go hog wild.
Ridiculously fun. A true advancement in the arcade racing genre and also a great Star Wars game

this game is really great, EXCEPT when the bullshit RNG decides to crash you for literally no fucking reason. But hopefully that'll get less frequent with future updates. I also don't fucking understand why some cutscenes are skippable but others just... aren't...? Fucking why?? I was so happy that this game has skippable cutscenes/dialogue because I frankly could not care less. But that just begs the question, why are some of them not skippable?? Makes literally no sense.
I love this game. Plays like a Star Wars Wipeout. It feels so fast and fun. Runs smoothly and looks beautiful.

I didn't realize this was a 'pick one thing from three options' type of roguelike. I was hoping it'd be more RPG/Progression based over a campaign.

Additionally it seems like the AI opponents have some very serious rubber banding + you pretty much are spending the entire race cycling between afterburners and ramjets. Pretty boring.

I refunded when I saw an opponent catch up to me suddenly from a 3+ second lead while I was boosting. What's the point if your boosts dont actually matter? Theres no strategy or reward for picking good lines.
10/10 amazing game. Most fun I've had racing and I'm not big on racing games outside of Mario Kart.

By far the best single player racing game I've played since Need for Speed Most Wanted on the playstation 2. Eclipses games like forza IMO.

On top of that, it's got an INCREDIBLE multiplayer, which is what the games really built around.

Only thing missing is custom lobbies so my friends and I can play private races and do silly rulesets. Hopefully that comes soon.
Bad level design, track direction is difficult to understand when you discover a track, and the way the game works (roguelite) makes a defeat very costly (and no restart race of course).

There are like six Podracers total. Six. The nerve. Gee I sure hope the G1-UP SH-T0 speeder bike is in my Star Wars Racing game!!!1! Look it's galactic fiend racing villain Kestar Bool and I guess we'll include that Sebulber guy in the Star Wars racing game for whatever reason

This game was really close to greatness. For a 30$ game it would have been fantastic. But unfortunately it's not a 30$ game. It's lacking a few things like key bindings and also the audio is very low. It has a really awkward click right stick to activate boost mechanic that feels over relied on. The forced camera when you wreck someone just stops your input and forces you into a wall. The ads for UPGRADE TO DELUXE were a bit much. Also I know I was playing on hard but why were the bikes hitting my landspeeder like they were an overweight 18 Wheeler and I was a bike?

Fantastic little nostalgia game for about an hour or so and then it shows that it would have been much better in an arcade cabinet rather than a PC/console game.

If they add the handful of QOL this game needs and some control/balancing changes, I will pick it back up when it goes on sale.

P.S. There was a real missed oportunity to add Vader's podracer.

If you like racing games, star wars and "roguelike", then you're going to have fun with this.
Singleplayer is good, has some interesting characters in it and a decent story about racing.
Multiplayer has different modes to play with:
1. Racing multiple maps fighting for money and rewards to upgrade your racer for the next match. (in 2 variations: non-pod-racing [12 player] and pod-racing [8 player])
2. Quickplay without upgrades and stuff

While it starts slow, you can later attain speeds that will make your head spin.

My favorite racing game - roguelike makes everything better. You feel like a hero - not just because of the classic star-wars sfx and characters, but because what you do is hard. You really are flying through corridors, twitching the steering sticks to stay alive. A game of consequences, and raw speed bliss.

its to simple for 60 dollars. i need deeper progression mechanics like actually starting from scratch on my racer and putting custom parts on it watching it develop race after race and maybe even the chance of it getting destroyed and then having to restart from scratch again. as it is you just get a racer, race it, and apply upgrades. for 40 dollars this works. for a full 60 dollar price tag its not worth it, its to shallow. maybe the next game will be deeper with more racers, more tracks, more planets, more takedowns and actual customizing your racer.

I love Star Wars and I love racing, especially when I can ram into racers like in Burnout. This game is insanely fun and I love all the Glup Shittos in here. DING DONG POOKIEEEE DING DONGGG. My PC is dookie so I have to set all the visuals to low, I wish I could have everything set to high because the environment, the character models, the speeders, EVERYTHING is so beautiful. Just a damn good time in the Star Wars universe.
This is the epitome of what video games are supposed to be. The only problem of this game is that I want more of it.

This game is extremely fun. Nothing has ever felt this fast in a video game before. I was hoping for just an updated Episode 1: Pod Racer. I got something waaaay better. Runs based gameplay is not what I was expecting. I don't even like Rogue Likes, and I think people have been misunderstanding how much like Rogue the system isn't. It feels like a continuous story from one run to the other. It's different enough each time to make each run fun and unique, but you build on your previous runs enough that losing doesn't suck that bad. Ramjet is brilliant. Can't wait to see what they do with it from here.
At least ~12 hours of gameplay. The racing is very fun, as you progress the speed gets very intense.
You go fast, you go speedy, you crash, you lose and you win. Every race is a thrill and fills you with excitement.

Pod Racer 2 this is not. There's so much fluff here, it takes so long to get into the races. Why is there so much dialog and walking around? It's just padding the play time! Snore!

The races are ok, but the tracks twist and turn so much that you can't actually tell which way is better to go, if it even matters, because the AI rubber banding is so bad.

And then there are decks for building the racer instead of, you know, actually buying parts?

Refunded.
The racing in this game is fantastic! That said you can't change keybinds...which is inconceivable in 2026 for a $60 game. Seriously, the indie game I'm developing has this already.

The game is amazing and addictive and my god when you get in that pod racer and you are zooming over 1000 miles an hour and you lock in gxng its like sex, you know just without the thrusting and finishing too quick because the races dont drag or nothing
game worked fine for 2 hours. it then got an update and afterwards it just kept crashing mid race. updated my graphics card driver and now it wont start. Typical AAA experience
A ton of fun, exhilirating and challenging to the extreme! Fullheartedly recommend, can't wait to crack open the multiplayer!

Really fun and good
Sebulba my beloved

This is the best Star Wars game made in the last decade and a it's a very good arcade racer. There's a lot of casual fun to be had in singleplayer and for anyone that wants a challenge there's champion difficulty and multiplayer. Gameplay has a surprising amount of depth and there is so much customization for vehicles, there are many paint styles and colors to choose, and changing vehicle parts alters their hitboxes so you can build a chunky vehicle that's better at ramming or a small one that takes sharp turns in confined spaces better. The gripes I have are that in MP some characters are extremely strong and some are so weak that they aren't worth using, and podracing content is very light so there needs to be future updates that add new pod maps and racers. This game is excellent and I hope it gets lots of updates and DLC.
Genuinely forgot they could make racing games that are actually fun instead of customization slop for car people
It's Burnout the Roguelite, but it's also Star Wars. Neither of those is a problem.

I'd like to give this game more runway to enjoy it but I am just as tempted to refund it as this is not worth the price currently. Maybe when they add obvious features and have a sale I'd recommend it.

-No key/controller rebinding outside of accessibility options
-No Flight Stick/Wheel support or configurability (This may be too arcade-y anyway to add better feel for sim minded racers but still)
-Overall sound is weirdly quiet compared to so many other games, sound design itself is solid though
-Limited Multiplayer and Single Player racing options compared to other racing titles
-Limited Planets/Biomes (feels like a corporate holdout for $20 DLC in 2 months)
-Denuvo (whatever but still bleh)
-Looks good but also still looks like another photorealistic Unreal Engine game with a Star Wars skin on it

Feels like an early access game that needs more time in the oven to get features and content right.

It's way better than it has any business being, my only complaint is that I'm forced to play as John Racer and not one of the cool aliens or characters from the movies or basically anyone other than what can only be described as default guy.

Most fun I've had with an arcade racer in a while and I really like the rogue-like take on the campaign. Very immersive sound and UI design, great voice acting from the campaign's antagonist too. General racing feels fast and there's a definite learning curve to "getting good" with the various systems in the game. AI is genuinely challenging on the step-up difficulty level in campaign.

You could afford to wait for a sale with the amount of content this offers right now, especially if you're not dying to race right now- but there's a decent skill-ceiling to the gameplay here and a lot of different ways to approach the racing itself. You'll get plenty of mileage out of this if you're looking for a multiplayer arcade racer to get stuck in with for a long time.

Brilliantly polished. Everything is such high quality and just flows so naturally. It manages the small miracle of making every race incredibly tense while simultaneously making failures relatively painless. Normally I'd expect those two to cancel each other out but they don't somehow.

Worth noting that the game's balance is not particularly good. Ramjet-based builds are much stronger than combat-based builds. Do not expect to win with brawler - try redliner or ramjet rider if you actually want to beat champion difficulty.
I've been patiently awaiting this release. Game stability has been an issue in the short time I attempted to play it. Refunded the game and may return to it later for a lower price. Very sad Day.

I am a huge racing game fan, but only certain styles. Forza doesnt really do it for me, I love games like Hot Wheels Unleashed etc This game is soooo good and if you like the hot wheels style of racing, this game is for you. The rougelite elements are awesome and you really do have to grind. So many additions to add to your racer as well.

I know some people have been writing bad reviews regarding the content depth and the k/m lack of binding, but honestly. There is enough content to keep you happy for a while. Just finding a racer you like and unlocking all the abilites etc will take time.

You can get to Sebulba pretty quickly, but beating him is another thing and you really do have to upgrade your racer enough to actually catch him.

10/10 for me,. I never buy games when they first come out, but I am glad I did

Very fun game. Enjoying the roguelike element a lot. Lots of fun to try new builds and challenge yourself to learn a new style and build.

Haven't palyed multiplayer yet but I've been having a blast with just replaying tha campaign.

Feels like an apology for Burnout: Paradise.

Performance tip: Read the "target FPS" tooltip carefully. The game can run better than you expect if it isn't busy churning away all of your GPU time trying to render pixels you'll never see.

This game's great! The speed, the sounds, the characters, the fiery explosions!

It really feels like you're flying through these maps and there are a lot of split second decisions you need to make. Fast routes are risky and require tight turns or you can drift through the outside and cut the corner as tight as you dare. The customization is fun although I wish there were better colors or more choices.

It' s an amazing racing game. I've spent 12 hours in the game and can't get enough. It's one of those rare few gems that you encounter. I can definitely recommend this game, even at full price.

Absolutely superb. I don't even play racing games, but this just FEELS so good, and was clearly made with extraordinary technical skill. It runs like a dream, and everything feels so intuitive, fast, and powerful.
Game is great but all of the fun is ruined when it crashes every 20 minutes making me lose progress

It's a Masterpiece. They managed to create a racing game where you will celebrate 9th/12 as much as getting Top 3, while being endlessly fun and addicting.

Beat the campaign in 8 hours and now I find myself waiting for something more!

I really enjoyed this but I hope they add more content down the line!

Probably one of the most entertaining racing games I have played since Forza Horizon 4. I do play iRacing, AC, AC Evo, Tokyo Extreme Racer. This game just provides a lot joy and challenge in tight courses. Wheeling a podracer is mad in this game. Graphics and map builds make you feel like you are in another galaxy.
